title: AILA Daily Pulse
description: Rolling list of DailyPulseItem objects fetched by the AILA app. English is canonical. German lives under i18n.de. At most 12 items. Ids and source URLs are never reused. Dates are not in the future.

id.description: Stable URL-safe id. Never reuse an id after an item rolls off the list.

date.description: Publication time in ISO-8601 UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-04T15:00:00.000Z. Must not be in the future. The UTC calendar date is the id prefix.

tag.description: Tools is for consumer and everyday products people can try today (ChatGPT features, free tiers, mobile apps, SDKs end users install), not for research papers or infrastructure alone.

priority.description: `breaking` marks major model/product launches the app may pin at the top; omit or use `normal` for routine daily items.

readTimeMinutes.description: Positive whole minutes to read the item. The same unit as listenTimeMinutes.

listenTimeMinutes.description: Positive whole minutes to listen to the same item.

hook.description: One sentence under the title. The hook or summaryPoints[0] should say what the thing is. The validator warns if neither does.

headline.description: 2-5 words, at most 32 characters (aim for 27 or fewer). Sentence case, unless the whole headline is title case. Glossary terms stay lowercase common nouns. Details belong in hook or summaryPoints.

shortTitle.description: Optional for older items. About 3-5 words that say what changes, not a bare product name. The validator warns when it is missing or longer than 24 characters.

summaryPoints.description: Exactly three strings: what the source shows, the limit of that claim, and what to check next. The first point or the hook should define the subject for a beginner.

takeaway.description: Optional. Up to three concrete to-dos the reader can do, each grounded in this item's source. Omit the field or use an empty string when there is no sensible to-do; the app hides the section.

deepDiveMarkdown.description: Exactly four second-level headings, in order: entry, how it works, the catch, what to do. Each heading is a specific statement about the story, at most 9 words, not ending with a period, never a template label. Aim for about 150-260 words in each section. Glossary terms in this English text are lowercase common nouns.

source.description: Exactly one source: the publisher name and a single https URL. Do not reuse the URL on another item.

name.description: Publisher name, for example TechCrunch or NVIDIA Newsroom.

url.description: Well-formed https URL of that publication. Optional network check: node scripts/validate.mjs --check-urls requires HTTP 200.

levels.description: Optional beginner and advanced variants. Root fields stay the intermediate text. Each variant has headline, hook, summaryPoints (exactly 3), deepDiveMarkdown, and de. takeaway and shortTitle are optional on the variant and on de. Omit a whole variant rather than leaving fields empty. Variant text must not copy the corresponding root text.

headline.description: Same limit as the English headline: 2-5 words, at most 32 characters (aim for 27 or fewer). German prose; technical AI terms stay in English.

shortTitle.description: Optional. German short title, about 3-5 words that say what changes. The validator warns when it is missing or longer than 24 characters. Technical AI terms stay in English.

takeaway.description: Optional. Up to three concrete German to-dos grounded in this item's source. Omit the field or use an empty string when there is no sensible to-do.

deepDiveMarkdown.description: Same four ## headings as the English deep dive. Technical AI terms stay in English.

levelVariant.description: A beginner or advanced telling of the same item. headline, hook, summaryPoints, deepDiveMarkdown, and de are required. takeaway and shortTitle may be omitted. The text must differ from the matching root fields.

headline.description: Same limit as the root headline: 2-5 words, at most 32 characters (aim for 27 or fewer).

shortTitle.description: Optional. About 3-5 words that say what changes. The validator warns when it is missing or longer than 24 characters.

takeaway.description: Optional. Up to three concrete to-dos grounded in this item's source. Omit the field or use an empty string when there is no sensible to-do.

deepDiveMarkdown.description: Exactly four ## sections, same heading rules as the root deep dive.
